text:
Maria Castillo: Quick proposal — add tenant_scope and visibility to audit events, plus signed_export field for KMS-signed blobs. Need to confirm: should members see only member-scoped events (create/update on resources they own) and admins see org-wide? Also thinking about redaction provenance so customers can prove redactions.

Kevin Li: Can you paste the rough schema?

Maria Castillo: Sure, rough sketch:
```
{
  event_type: user.login
  tenant_id: tenant_123
  tenant_scope: project|org
  visibility: admin|member|system
  actor: sam@acme.com
  redaction: { fields_removed: [prompt, input_blob], reason: pii }
  signed_export_ref: kms://s3/exports/evt-123.sig
}
```

Olivia Park: :eyes: For visibility, my vote: default is member-limited for member tokens. Admin tokens get expanded view. But we need a way to request escalated view for support agents (audit path) with explicit consent and an immutable audit trail of who elevated.

Samir Patel: Agreed. Also two questions:
1) How do scoped tokens factor? If a scoped token is issued with 'audit:read', does that map to visibility=member or admin?
2) Are signed_export_ref blobs enough for customer validation or do we need per-event signature+
hash? :lock:

Maria Castillo: Answers:
1) Scoped tokens should be limited to tenant_scope included at issuance time. So 'audit:read' scoped token for a member can only read events with tenant_scope=project the token was scoped to.
2) Prefer per-export KMS signing (batch) with per-event hash inside the batch manifest. Both signed_export_ref and per-event hashes give tamper evidence without requiring us to sign each event inline.

Kevin Li: We should add a 'visibility_reasons' array so UI can show why an event was hidden/redacted. E.g., ['pii-redaction','member-only']

Olivia Park: Also add 'redaction_proof' field that points to signed_export_ref if full proof needed.

audit-bot: New proposal created: RFC-2026-AUDIT-SCHEMA. Link: https://go/infra/rfc/2026

Samir Patel: Migration plan idea: keep old events readable via admin-only migration tool, emit new events as side-by-side for 90 days, then run backfill that preserves redaction markers. We need a test harness for customer-facing export validation.

Maria Castillo: +1 on test harness. Also need to update policy docs explaining admin vs member views and include an incident-runbook step: 'if customer requests full audit export, require legal/consent + KMS audit-signature check'.

Kevin Li: One more thing — vulnerability triage: if an exploit can escalate visibility (admin-flag flipping), that must trigger immediate token revocation and rotation of KMS signing keys. Add to incident playbook.

Olivia Park: I'll mock up a UI snippet for 'export proof' UX and policy text. Samir can you draft the migration script checklist?

Samir Patel: Yup, I'll start a branch and ping here when ready. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Maria Castillo: Thanks everyone. If no blockers, I'll file the RFC and schedule a 30m sync.

Olivia Park: :thumbsup:
